scope: Real LX7 MMIO: all19 exact memory/controls; real RMT RGB; ETH SPI SD roundtrip/wrong-route/eject/partial-write; old8RO native SD/RTC/expander; Relay6 six coils; LCD3 RGB DMA/CS42/P0-P2 reset and BL gates/CST820/GT911 strap/LEDC.
regression: Eight existing TCA-RGB unit tests plus focused Clippy; full repository gates owned by integration parent.
limitations: Partial source-bounded digital simulation. Physical hardware, complete original factory applications and browser/WebGL acceptance are not claimed.
Old8DI8RO has RS485, not C-revision CAN. TCA9554+PCF85063 SDA42/SCL41,DI4..11,RGB38wireRGB,buzzer46 and native SD48/47/45.
8relay coil states are digital controls; relay contacts, W5500 network, PoE/optocouplers/RS485 peer and electrical loads remain unmodeled.
